text:
maria: Heads up — postmortem for the recent failover/caching incident is merged. We need owners for runbook and playbook updates. Who can take triage steps + commands?

jin: I can own the triage checklist changes. Will take point on the explicit commands and playbook sequence.

sam: I'll pick up automation and the test harness for the runbook (can add smoke scripts).

ops-bot: Reminder: link postmortem and include a PR that references the postmortem ID. Use template: https://redwood.internal/templates/runbook-change.md :memo:

alex: Observed recurring pattern: failover -> cache eviction -> traffic spike. We should add a dedicated triage step to verify eviction rates and cache warmup. Suggest command: `curl -s http://metrics.cluster.internal/cache/evictions | jq -r .rate` and a quick check for >1000/min.

leo: small formatting ask — standardize runbook examples to include `--json` output for machine parsing.

maria: Proposed owners + deadlines: jin (triage steps & commands) by EOW Friday, sam (automation + test harness) by next Wed, alex (alerts + escalation) by next Fri, leo (doc format & validation) by next Tue. Can we all commit to that?

jin: EOW Friday works. I'll open the runbook PR and include the exact command snippets and short rationale.

sam: I'll create `scripts/runbook-smoke.sh` and a unit test in `infra/tests/runbook_smoke_test.py`. Example script: 
```
#!/bin/bash
set -e
# simulate traffic to staging
ab -n 500 -c 20 http://staging/health || true
# basic KV cache sanity check
python tools/check_kv_cache.py --threshold 0.8 --json
```

alex: For escalation, add a 15-minute paging SLA for critical failovers. Escalation chain: primary oncall -> backup oncall -> eng-sre lead -> eng-infra. Add runbook snippet with contact matrix and example Slack pings.

maria: Also add a step to run `redis-cli --stat` / `redis-cli INFO` after failover and provide a short warmup command. Jin/sam — can we have a warmup script?

jin: Proposed warmup command: `python scripts/warm_cache.py --pattern \"user:*\" --concurrency 20 --dry-run` and a guidance line to run with `--no-dry-run` only after confirming low latency. I'll add to PR.

sam: I'll implement `warm_cache.py` with a throttling option and a flag to skip heavy keys. Will include integration test in the smoke harness.

alex: Alerting tweaks: add an alert on cache eviction rate > 500/min AND CPU spike > 70% for 3 minutes. Also add a runbook action to temporarily route traffic to lower-capacity model variant: `redwoodctl route set --model=m-quantized-v2 --weight=1.0` as emergency fallback for GPU OOMs.

leo: Minor: document examples should show `--json` outputs and include line that shows how to grep for key metrics, e.g., `redis-cli INFO | grep used_memory_human`.

maria: Ops-bot, can you create JIRA/GH issues for these action items and assign owners? Tag security for KMS verification too.

ops-bot: Created issue RW-PT-983 assigned: jin, sam, alex, leo. Added label: postmortem-followup.

sam: I'll run a simulated failover test (dry run) next Wednesday and report findings back here with logs.

jin: One more note on recurring patterns — when cache warms slowly after failover, downstream services queue requests causing backpressure on routing. We should add a step to temporarily lower concurrency for worker pools: `kubectl scale deploy worker --replicas=2` + backoff config. I'll add that as an optional step in the triage checklist.

maria: Thanks — summary of owners confirmed: jin (triage + commands), sam (automation + tests), alex (alerts + escalation), leo (doc formatting + validation). Deadlines: PRs by 2026-04-03, merge by 2026-04-10. I'll create calendar reminders and follow up on status. :thumbsup:

alex: ack.

leo: ack.

jin: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/runbooks/pull/812 — includes triage steps, commands, and the warmup plan. Please review.

sam: PR for scripts: https://github.com/redwood/infra-scripts/pull/210 opened, includes `runbook-smoke.sh` and `warm_cache.py` (dry-run).

maria: Great progress. After PR merges, we'll schedule a canary runbook drill and mark the postmortem action item as resolved. I'll keep this thread updated with any blockers.
